try:
    shape = (8194, 1)
    indices_2d = np.arange(np.prod(shape), dtype=np.intp)[:, None]
    # The element at flat-index position 8193
    element = indices_2d[8193]
    # Round-trip through unravel_index and ravel_multi_index
    multi_index = np.unravel_index(element, shape)
    result_1 = np.ravel_multi_index(multi_index, shape)
    probe("indices_2d = np.arange(np.prod(shape), dtype=np.intp)[:, None] with shape=(8194,1); the element at flat-index position 8193 is fed through an np.unravel_index/ravel_multi_index round-trip", result_1)
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception("indices_2d = np.arange(np.prod(shape), dtype=np.intp)[:, None] with shape=(8194,1); the element at flat-index position 8193 is fed through an np.unravel_index/ravel_multi_index round-trip", e)

try:
    a = np.arange(10).reshape(10, 1)
    i = np.nditer(a, ['buffered', 'multi_index'], buffersize=5)
    i.remove_multi_index()
    i.enable_external_loop()
    
    # Check ndim
    ndim_check = (i.ndim == 1)
    
    # Concatenate chunks
    chunks = []
    for chunk in i:
        chunks.append(chunk.copy())
    concatenated = np.concatenate(chunks)

    result_2 = {

        'concatenated_chunks': concatenated,
        'chunks_equal_ravel': chunks_equal
    }
    probe("a = np.arange(10).reshape(10, 1); i = nditer(a, ['buffered', 'multi_index'], buffersize=5); i.remove_multi_index(); i.enable_external_loop(); then assert i.ndim == 1 and concatenated chunks equal a.ravel()", result_2)
